title: Apex Vision Frames Prime
alludes_to: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 3) — camera glasses
description: Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses (Gen 3) — camera glasses is the nominative anchor for this record. The Apex Vision Frames Prime carries the same working details — nine-hour battery with six microphones, from $449 — rendered as a fully original Signature work. It reached the market in 2026, aimed at everyday wearers.
